source_brief.standout: Nested angular shells use repeated scales to make a shallow opening feel like a deep crystalline chamber.
source_brief.scene: A glowing geode cavern sculpture constructed from FIVE nested jagged polygonal wireframe shells on visible low dark bases, amber crystal rims outside graduating to mint and ice-blue smaller inner rims, repeated finite triangular crystal ribs. Dramatic receding black opening, physically narrowing interior and offset depths create an exaggerated deep-cavern illusion. No massive solid rock surface; all primary visual material is buildable open light frames.
